strings.heading: Microphone priority
strings.auto_select: Always choose a microphone using this priority
strings.reserve: 2. Backup microphone — when primary is unavailable
strings.auto_off_help: Your choices are saved. Automatic selection is off; macOS chooses the default microphone.
strings.priority_help: Use the primary microphone first; use the backup when it is unavailable. Bluetooth microphones are excluded.
strings.backup_active: Primary microphone unavailable. Using backup: {device}. The primary will be selected when it returns.
strings.both_unavailable: Both selected microphones are unavailable. The built-in Mac microphone is the final fallback; Bluetooth microphones are excluded.
strings.background_help: Closing this window keeps the app running in the background.
strings.agent_changed: The startup configuration does not belong to this app.
strings.invalid_pack: Use a valid JSON language file with id, name and strings. Preserve the placeholders from the English template. Built-in en/uk languages cannot be replaced through import.
strings.template_note: Change id to your language code and name to its native name. Translate values in strings. Keep keys and placeholders such as {device} unchanged. Import the saved JSON file through Add language from file.
